[Section] Conclusion
[source_id=40] In this paper we developed a CUI-based upper bound on extractive summarization of discharge summaries and presented a NN architecture that jointly classifies words in history of present illness notes. We demonstrate that our model can achieve excellent performance on a small dataset with known heterogeneity among annotators. This model can be applied to the 55,000 discharge summaries in MIMIC to create a dataset for evaluation of extractive summarization methods.
